newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian OTC market gains in turnover.
newsitem.headline: Romanian OTC market gains in turnover.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market was very active this week with turnover more than doubling on the previous week to more than 27 billion lei.
Volume on the RASDAQ, an OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ exchange, was 6.6 million shares, up from some 4.0 million last week.
Traders said investors had focused on cement makers and oil refineries.
Cement maker Romcim Bucuresti SA was the most active, taking the bulk of trades and accounting for 80 percent of the total turnover.
Romcim's shares closed at 29,000 lei on Friday, 3,000 lei weaker on the week.
Traders expect a correction of Romcim shares next week due to stronger supply and say overall turnover will be on the rise.
The unofficial VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by brokerage house Vanguard SA, rose by 4.5 percent on the week to 1,380 points.
The RASDAQ, which opened last October, lists 2,327 companies. An average 160 of these trade each day this week. ($=6,069 lei)
